# Plugins

All plugins are vendored in-repo via `git subtree` (see `scripts/plugins.tsv` / `plugins.lock`); nothing is downloaded at Neovim startup.

## Always loaded (`pack/vendor/start/`)

| Plugin | Upstream | Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| plenary.nvim | https://github.com/nvim-lua/plenary.nvim | always (library dependency) |
| nvim-web-devicons | https://github.com/nvim-tree/nvim-web-devicons | always |
| catppuccin | https://github.com/catppuccin/nvim | always (colorscheme) |
| nvim-treesitter | https://github.com/nvim-treesitter/nvim-treesitter | always (does not support lazy-loading) |
| nvim-cmp | https://github.com/hrsh7th/nvim-cmp | always (insert-mode completion) |
| cmp-nvim-lsp | https://github.com/hrsh7th/cmp-nvim-lsp | always |
| cmp-buffer | https://github.com/hrsh7th/cmp-buffer | always |
| cmp-path | https://github.com/hrsh7th/cmp-path | always |
| LuaSnip | https://github.com/L3MON4D3/LuaSnip | always (snippet engine) |
| cmp_luasnip | https://github.com/saadparwaiz1/cmp_luasnip | always |
| friendly-snippets | https://github.com/rafamadriz/friendly-snippets | always (snippet data, lazy_load()'d) |
| gitsigns.nvim | https://github.com/lewis6991/gitsigns.nvim | always |
| lualine.nvim | https://github.com/nvim-lualine/lualine.nvim | always (statusline) |
| which-key.nvim | https://github.com/folke/which-key.nvim | always (leader popup) |
| mason.nvim | https://github.com/mason-org/mason.nvim | always (commands only; no auto-refresh) |
| conform.nvim | https://github.com/stevearc/conform.nvim | always |
| nvim-lint | https://github.com/mfussenegger/nvim-lint | always |
| nvim-autopairs | https://github.com/windwp/nvim-autopairs | always |
| nvim-surround | https://github.com/kylechui/nvim-surround | always |

## Loaded on demand (`pack/vendor/opt/`)

| Plugin | Upstream | Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| telescope.nvim | https://github.com/nvim-telescope/telescope.nvim | first <leader>f* keypress or :Telescope |
| nvim-tree.lua | https://github.com/nvim-tree/nvim-tree.lua | first <leader>e keypress or :NvimTreeToggle |
| oil.nvim | https://github.com/stevearc/oil.nvim | first <leader>o keypress, "-", or :Oil |
| trouble.nvim | https://github.com/folke/trouble.nvim | first <leader>xx keypress or :Trouble |
| render-markdown.nvim | https://github.com/MeanderingProgrammer/render-markdown.nvim | FileType markdown |
| vimtex | https://github.com/lervag/vimtex | FileType tex,plaintex,bib |
| rainbow_csv | https://github.com/mechatroner/rainbow_csv | FileType csv,tsv |
| nvim-dap | https://github.com/mfussenegger/nvim-dap | first debug keymap (<leader>d*) |
| nvim-dap-ui | https://github.com/rcarriga/nvim-dap-ui | first debug session actually started |
| nvim-nio | https://github.com/nvim-neotest/nvim-nio | dependency of nvim-dap-ui, same trigger |
